Browser-based deep learning

O-GlcNAcPRED-DL

Predict human and mouse protein O-GlcNAcylation sites from FASTA sequences with an ensemble deep-learning model.

Start a prediction Read the tutorial

About the model

Sequence-based candidate site prediction

O-GlcNAcylation functions in a protein- and site-specific manner. Despite substantial progress in experimentally mapping O-GlcNAc sites, the task remains challenging in many cases. We constructed the ensemble model O-GlcNAcPRED-DL to predict O-GlcNAc sites on proteins using deep-learning approaches.

Compared with existing methods, O-GlcNAcPRED-DL shows improved sensitivity and accuracy. We anticipate that it will be a valuable tool for expediting the discovery of O-GlcNAc sites on proteins, especially human and mouse proteins, and for elucidating their functions in physiology and disease.

Cite O-GlcNAcPRED-DL

Hu F., Li W., Li Y., Hou C., Ma J., and Jia C. O-GlcNAcPRED-DL: prediction of protein O-GlcNAcylation sites based on an ensemble model of deep learning. Journal of Proteome Research. 2024, 23(1), 95–106. DOI: 10.1021/acs.jproteome.3c00458.
